name: Supplies to Auberdine
summary: Feero Ironhand carries provisions and messages north from Maestra's Post toward Auberdine, with Alliance adventurers guarding the way. Trouble around the Tower of Althalaxx and hostile infiltrators make the road unsafe.

sections.title: A Perilous Road North
sections.body: Maestra's Post lies on Ashenvale's western frontier, between the forest and Darkshore. After investigations into sinister activity around the Tower of Althalaxx, Delgren the Purifier sends supplies and intelligence to Sentinel Starbreeze in Auberdine. The outpost relies on armed escorts instead of solitary couriers, so Feero Ironhand travels with guards along the forest road.

sections.title: Shadows Along the Trail
sections.body: Feero Ironhand's road north brings him through woods where ambushes threaten his delivery. Cultists of the Dark Strand seek to silence reports of their demonic rituals. Forsaken scouts stalk the underbrush, while Balizar the Umbrage, Aligar the Tormentor, and Caedakar the Vicious each attempt to cut down the caravan before it reaches the border.

faq.answer: Feero Ironhand is a human courier stationed at Maestra's Post in western Ashenvale. Delgren the Purifier entrusts him with messages and logistical aid for Auberdine, and he will not travel without capable bodyguards.

faq.q: Why does Auberdine need these supplies?
faq.answer: Darkshore and northern Ashenvale face growing corruption and threats from demonic cultists operating out of the Tower of Althalaxx. The night elf Sentinels in Auberdine, led locally by Sentinel Starbreeze, need provisions and current intelligence to defend the coast.

faq.q: Who attacks Feero along the road?
faq.answer: Feero warns that dangerous foes operate throughout the forest and asks for guards. Their identities become clear during the escort.

faq.q: What is the connection to the Tower of Althalaxx?
faq.answer: Delgren the Purifier is orchestrating efforts to uncover and disrupt the dark rituals of the cultists at the Tower of Althalaxx. This escort grows from that investigation, carrying intelligence and support to the Night Elf leadership in Auberdine.

faq.q: Where do I report after protecting Feero?
aliases: where do i go after escorting feero
faq.answer: After you see Feero safely through the Ashenvale ambushes, you report to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post and confirm the delivery succeeded.

angles.text: By safeguarding this route, you help keep Ashenvale's outposts connected to Auberdine, preserving the Alliance's fragile hold on northern Kalimdor.
The supplies and dispatches you escort north aid the Sentinels in Auberdine as they face growing darkness across Darkshore and along the Ashenvale border.
As a human, you see Feero Ironhand represent your people's willingness to support kaldorei allies in unfamiliar, dangerous ancient forests.
